title: finding(docs): scroll-area.mdx documents a `content` member neither `ScrollAreaSchema` declares nor `ui:scroll-area` reads — and calls the only working key "alternative"
body:
Found while fixing objectui#8197 (the `collapsible.mdx` content-slot row). Exact mirror of that card, on a different page. Measured on `origin/main` `f57ca757b`.

## The rows

`content/docs/components/complex/scroll-area.mdx:38-40` publishes:

```plaintext
  // Content
  content?: SchemaNode | SchemaNode[];  // Scrollable content
  children?: SchemaNode | SchemaNode[]; // Alternative content prop
```

Both lines are wrong, in opposite directions:

1. **`content` is not a member of anything.** `packages/types/src/layout.ts:488-507` declares `ScrollAreaSchema extends BaseSchema` with exactly `type`, `height?`, `width?`, `orientation?`, `children?`. There is no `content`. `BaseSchema` does not carry one either. So the page's *first* content row names a key no declaration has.
2. **`children` is not an "alternative", it is the only channel.** `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/scroll-area.tsx:34` is `renderChildren(schema.children)` — the single content read in the renderer — and the registration's `defaultProps` ships `children`. Nothing reads `schema.content`.

⇒ an author reading top-to-bottom takes the first content row, authors `content`, and gets an empty scroll box. Same failure mode as objectui#8197, same page family.

## Relationship to objectui#6805

objectui#6805 ("all seven components-complex-scroll-area demos author their body under `content`, which ui:scroll-area never reads") is closed. That card's scope was the **demo catalog**, not the reference page — the doc rows above were not in it and are still on main. This card is the docs half.

## Why no gate catches it

`check:doc-types` reads only `type` string literals out of doc code blocks, so it never judges a member row (verified: it passes on this tree). `check:doc-snippets` compiles only `ts` / `tsx` / `typescript` fences (`TS_FENCE_LANGUAGES`, `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs:548`); this block is fenced `plaintext`, so it is outside that gate's population by construction. Gate-blindness class: objectui#6143.

## Suggested fix

Delete the `content?` row and relabel `children?` as the content channel, re-derived from the declaration. Whoever picks it up should also decide whether the page's "Base properties" section (lines 45-48) is still the right shape.

Not fixed under objectui#8197: different page, different component, out of that card's scope fence.
